strictSelectionRule: per session, best objective per symbol among trainR>0, validationR>0, PF>=1.1, entries>=40, maxDD<=12R; keep up to five without backfill
coverageRepairRule: strict selection plus best New York cell with both folds positive, entries>=40 and maxDD<=12R when no strict New York cell exists; PF and week/day gates are not weakened in final evaluation

protocol.sizing: fixed EUR 500 upside, balance-sensitive downside; quote-currency conversion at entry/exit
protocol.execution: closed-candle signals, next-M1 entry, bid/ask prices, conservative SL-first OHLC ambiguity; weekday-only entries and forced daily flat
